details:
The current "Creator" tag appearing only for users who have uploaded content to the marketplace is a misnomer and may be offensive or excluding members of the wider community of Creators who upload avatars or worlds to the VRChat platform. It also excludes creators who sell exclusively on third-party platforms such as BOOTH, Gumroad, Jinxxy, PayHip, etc.

The Creator Economy documentations name these users with marketplace content as "Seller":

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/welcome-to-the-ce

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/getting-started

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/products/

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/products/avatar

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/products/udon

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/listings

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/subscriptions

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/store/

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/payout

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/getting-started

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/testing

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/udon-documentation

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/open-listing

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/open-group-page

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/open-world-store

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/debug-logging

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/floating-overhead

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/product-owners-instance

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/product-owners-only

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/product-toggle

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/supporter-list

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/sdk/examples/timed-event

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/faq

- https://creators.vrchat.com/economy/guidelines

I suggest the tag be renamed to "Seller", be applied to anyone who has uploaded private or public content to VRChat, or otherwise be reconsidered for implementation.
title: [1880] The "Creator" tag is a misnomer.
